name: us-corps-of-discovery
description: Corps of Discovery: Mission West — Unit 4 U.S. History expedition survival game (TEKS 8.5C, 8.6B, 8.10A, 8.11A, 8.31B). Co-command the real 1804-1806 Lewis & Clark expedition across six legs and twelve decisions, where the right call is almost always the one the Corps actually made: prepare, hold discipline, and trust the Native nations whose land it already was. Server-authoritative Socket.IO backend with a live Teacher Command Center.
comment: No npm workspaces: this drive is exFAT, which cannot host the symlinks/junctions workspace linking requires. server/ and client/ install independently; `npm install` here cascades via postinstall.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --no-fund --no-audit && npm install --prefix client --no-fund --no-audit
